notes: *piece by piece* is split: *by* to the distributive לְ, both occurrences of *piece* to נְתָחֶי as one discontinuous unit under rule 25 headed on the first, and the suffix unrepresented under rule 22. Fusing all three under rule 30 was the competing reading, defeated because the ASV spends *piece* on the noun in particular.
*burnt them* supplies an object with no object morpheme in the clause, so *them* is `added` under rule 44.
